Get the latest manatee sighting reports from our Blue Spring researchers.

December 29 – The river temp was 70.3º F (21.3°C) with 51 manatees for roll call.

Tuesday, December 30 – No roll call today; the water was too murky.

December 31 – Only a low estimate of 477 was possible. The park counted 670.

January 2 – The river temperature was 64.2°F (17.9°C), with researchers counting 186 manatees while the park counted 191.

Adoptees seen: Lily and Brutus.

January 3 – With air temps near 46°F (~8°C), researchers decided to do a roll call. The river temp was 69.4°F (~20.8°C) with 32 additional manatees counted.

Jan. 5 – River temp was 69.8°F (21°C) with 65 manatees counted.
